tests.name: Onboarding: annual trial vs weekly first
tests.action: Keep “Weekly first”: it wins on both paid conversion and 60-day revenue per user ($8.56 vs $4.51). Watch refunds, since they are higher at 11.5% of payers vs 9.6%.

tests.name: Settings: upgrade vs lifetime anchor
tests.action: Do not switch to “Settings - Upgrade”: “Lifetime anchor” converts better at 24.8% vs 17.9%, and the revenue lift is not backed. Keep “Lifetime anchor” or re-run only if you have a new variant.

tests.name: Main: 3 plans vs lifetime anchor (NA)
tests.action: Read this on a longer window before making a final call: “Lifetime anchor” is ahead at 60 days, but the lead shrinks from $9.30 at day 7 to $3.11 by day 110. Keep watching renewals because 44.3% of “Lifetime anchor” revenue is one-time lifetime purchases.
